dct_description_sm: EOS Eco-Energy is a small, charitable organization based in Sackville, New Brunswick. In 2017, EOS established the Chignecto Area Watersheds Monitoring Program, with an aim to maintain the long-term sustainability of our local watersheds by promoting watershed awareness through citizen science, public education, conducting long-term water quality monitoring, and performing subsequent restoration and protection activities. In 2025, EOS received funds from Environment Canada's EcoAction Community Funding Program to support the development of a Silver Lake Association. As part of this initiative, EOS has partnered with the Municipality of Tantramar to archive their historic Silver Lake bacteria and cyanobacteria data collected as part of routine recreational water quality management of Lillas Fawcett Park public beach. Since 2017, municipal staff have collected two bacteria (Escherichia coli) samples once per week from June through to end of August. Cyanobacteria sample collection began in 2021, with two samples collected one to two times per season.
dct_title_s: Municipality of Tantramar Silver Lake Data
